title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_the_lawrence_browne_affair_by_cat_sebastian_vi2g8 (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_the_lawrence_browne_affair_by_cat_sebastian_vi2g8' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or run. Installation of this package may lead to complete system takeover by an external attacker. Removal of the package alone does not guarantee elimination of all malicious software introduced. Immediate rotation of all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer is strongly advised, and this should be done from a different, uncompromised machine.
